text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Traineeeeer!
I did it, I did it! I beat Taishin--!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~, my heart was racing!!
Races against Taishin really get my nerves going!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haa, I'm so happy... *sniffle*

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHOAAA!?
Taishin!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Um, today's race, it, it was really, really incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...'Glad'?
You're glad I tried my best?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ha, you've gotta be kidding me...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: NO NO NOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin's "I'm definitely gonna win!" spirit
was crackling like crazy right from inside the gates!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Honestly... I got a little intimidated. Taishin just looked sooooo huge out there!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“But... that's why there was NO WAAAAAY
I was gonna lose either!!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We had the most exhilarating race.
So it turned out really, really great!

As Winning Ticket spoke with fiery passion,
Narita Taishin's eyes wavered slightly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...... Ah, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I won't back down for anything.
The Satsuki Sho is mine, absolutely...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Me too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
Winning Ticket successfully won the match against Narita Taishin.

The days of training alongside her rivals
toward their next race, the Satsuki Sho, begin!
